definitions.explanation: The part that remains after other parts have been used, removed, or dealt with.

examples.japanese: {残|のこ}りは{明日|あした}やりましょう。
{残|のこ}りの{時間|じかん}で{復習|ふくしゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please review in the remaining time.

examples.japanese: ケーキの{残|のこ}りを{食|た}べてもいいですか。
examples.english: May I eat the rest of the cake?

notes:
{残|のこ}り is the noun form of the verb {残|のこ}る (to remain).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {残|のこ}りの + noun (remaining ~)
- ～の{残|のこ}り (the rest of ~)
- {残|のこ}り{物|もの} (leftovers, remains)

RELATED WORDS:
- {残|のこ}る: to remain (intransitive verb)
- {残|のこ}す: to leave behind (transitive verb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {残|のこ}り: remainder (noun)
- あと: remainder, rest (casual)
- {余|あま}り: surplus, excess
